Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [Your Turn] effect mean?

Card Q&A.a: No, this effect only applies during your turn. Your opponent's turn continues until the memory moves to 1 or more from your perspective.

The memory moved to 3 or more on my opponent's side and the turn ended while this card's [Your Turn] effect was activated. If the memory moves to 1 or 2 on my opponent's side due to an [End of Your Turn] effect, does my turn continue?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect is a "You may play" effect, but it doesn't include "up to," therefore you must choose to either play no cards or as many as possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play just 2 of the target cards from my trash when [Eiji Nagasumi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards and I have 3 or more level 4 or lower cards with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait in my trash?

Card Q&A.a: The memory will move to 3 on your opponent's side, and the turn will end if there are no other effects pending activation, etc.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I declare a "pass" when I have this Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower card with the [Dark Animal] or [SoC] trait from your trash without paying the cost. If [Eiji Nagasumi] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 2 to the number of cards this effect may play.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon, unsuspend this Digimon. For each of your Digimon, add 1 to the level this effect may choose.
[Your Turn] The turn end condition is the opponent having 3 or more memory.
